vibe_rationale: National design month run by the culture ministry; broad and institutional rather than community-run, though it gathers the independent design scene.
fit_notes: Design-industry professionals, students and a design-literate public, with weak wellness adjacency. The 1,200 figure is a registration count for official activities, not total visitors, so the band is indicative. Partner logos appear on the site but no names were captured. As a government umbrella, sponsorship is unlikely to be the route.
